description: This source file defines an enumeration `LocalNetworkURLSupport` that provides a utility method to determine if a given URL points to a local network (loopback). It includes a function `isLocalNetworkHTTPURL` that checks URL scheme and host to classify local network URLs.

methods.name: isLocalNetworkHTTPURL
methods.description: Checks if a URL is an HTTP or HTTPS URL pointing to a local network by verifying scheme and host.
